app_alert.code:
String says = device.alert();   // "" when no dialog is up
if (!says.isEmpty()) System.out.println(says);

app_background.code: device.background(5);   // back in front, resumed, when this returns

app_battery.code:
Map<String, Object> battery = device.battery();
System.out.println(battery.get("level") + "% " + battery.get("state"));

app_check.code: device.check("testid=termsCheck", true);   // does nothing if it is already ticked

app_crashes.code:
List<Map<String, Object>> crashes = device.crashes("com.example.shop", 0);   // 0: the default limit
for (var c : crashes) System.out.println(c.get("time") + " " + c.get("summary"));

app_find.code:
List<Element> buttons = device.find("role=button");
for (Element b : buttons) System.out.println(b.ref() + " " + b.label());

app_launch.code: device.launch("com.android.settings");   // returns once it is in front

app_lock.code: boolean locked = device.screenLocked(true);   // true, read back

app_logs.code:
Map<String, Object> log = device.deviceLogs("com.example.shop", "error", 0);   // 0: the default line limit
System.out.println(log.get("entries"));

app_network.code: Map<String, Object> network = device.setOffline(true);   // read back once airplane mode holds

app_open_url.code: String app = device.openUrl("myapp://cart");   // the app that ended up in front

app_record.code:
Map<String, Object> video = device.record("stop", "flow.mp4");
System.out.println(video.get("frames") + " frames");

app_scroll_to.code: Element row = device.scrollTo("text=System");   // down is the default

app_source.code:
Map<String, Object> source = device.source();
Files.writeString(Path.of("screen.xml"), (String) source.get("source"));

app_state.code:
Map<String, Object> state = device.appState("com.android.settings");
boolean running = !"not_running".equals(state.get("state"));

app_storage.code: Map<String, Object> state = device.storage();   // cookies, and each origin's storage

app_time.code:
Map<String, Object> clock = device.deviceTime();
System.out.println(clock.get("time") + " " + clock.get("zone"));

app_wait_for.code: device.waitFor("role=progressbar", WaitFor.hidden());   // returns null: nothing left to point at

app_zoom.code: device.zoom("in", "");   // "": about the middle of the screen

start.title: Open a session and launch the app fresh

connect.title: Connect without touching the device

platform.title: Pick iOS when both are attached

app.title: Launch an app as the session starts

binary.title: Use a mobium binary that is not on PATH

callTimeout.title: Bound every call

session.title: Name a session of your own
Read what start() opened

quit.title: End the session explicitly

close.title: Close a connection, leaving the session open

sessions.title: List the sessions open on the daemon

step.title: Build steps for a batch

MobiumException.title: Read what failed and what to do

details.title: Find the step a batch stopped at

NoSuchElementException.title: Scroll when a tap finds nothing

TimedOutException.title: Handle a wait that never held

AmbiguousLocatorException.title: Narrow a locator that matched twice

UnsupportedException.title: Skip what a platform lacks

DeviceNotReadyException.title: Unlock before launching

NoDeviceException.title: Report that nothing is attached

NoSuchAlertException.title: Answer a dialog only if one is up

NoSuchContextException.title: Switch to a WebView that may not be there

ElementNotReachableException.title: Handle a target that cannot be reached

NotConfirmedException.title: Handle a change the device did not confirm

InvalidArgumentException.title: A null is refused before anything is sent

DeviceServerException.title: Retry once when the device server says so

InternalException.title: Report an internal failure

visible.title: Wait for an element to appear

hidden.title: Wait for a spinner to go

text.title: Wait until an element's text contains a string

enabled.title: Wait for a button to become tappable

disabled.title: Wait for a button to be disabled

checked.title: Wait for a checkbox to be checked

unchecked.title: Wait for a switch to be off

focused.title: Wait for a field to take focus

not.title: Wait for a text to stop matching

centerX.title: Tap the middle of an element's bounds

width.title: Measure an element
width.code:
Bounds b = device.waitFor("testid=banner").bounds();
System.out.println(b.width() + "x" + b.height() + " px");

Element.title: Read what map hands out
Element.code:
Element e = device.find("text=Sign in").get(0);
System.out.println(e.ref() + " " + e.role() + " " + e.bounds() + " checked=" + e.checked());

Location.title: Read where the device believes it is
Location.code:
Location here = device.location();
if (here.mock) System.out.println(here.latitude + ", " + here.longitude);

answerAlert.title: Fill a prompt's field and accept it, in one call

intro.install:
git clone https://github.com/mobiumdev/mobium.git
cd mobium/clients/java && ./mvnw -q install -DskipTests
